Publish.LongDescription:
## Mochi's Hover Colors
Want to change the bright blue highlights?
**Easy tool to Dim, Hide, or Change highlights to any color, opacity strength, or line thickness.**
### Highlights
- 1-click change highlight color + transparency. - **NEW: Change outline thickness** from thin to thick. - **NEW: Fill color** and outline color are now separate. - Full color picker — click on any color or exact HEX value. - Works on buildings, cars, trees, citizens, props, roads, and more. - **1-Click Eye button** to hide/show highlights anytime. - Hover over buttons for quick tooltip help. - Restore vanilla colors anytime with 1-click.
### Guidelines + Area Tools
- **Guidelines:** change colors and opacity for roads, spacing lines, and previews. - **Surfaces:** hide the cloudy preview fill so you can see the real ground. - **Specialized Industry:** hide lot previews while drawing farms, forestry, oil, ore, and other industry areas. - **Districts:** change border + overlay color and opacity.
### Panel + Options - Bulldozer + Road tool color choices are in the Options menu. - NEW: works in Editor Mode: use the main panel hotkey to open the panel (default J).
## Good to Know
- **To start:** click the Hover Colors palette icon (top-left icon). - **Works with Recolor:** Hover Colors changes highlights, guidelines, overlays, and previews. Recolor changes the actual objects. - **Lightweight:** no Harmony patches and Safe to remove anytime. - Alpha = transparency. Click any color box, a full color picker opens. Use the last bar. - Performance friendly: HC applies changes when needed, then stays idle.
### Support + Feedback
- Enjoy and the easiest way to support is clicking the Like 👍 button (top right) — no donations requested. - Feedback: use the GitHub or Discord links (icons right side). - MIT open source.
### ❤️ Credits and Thanks
**Huge thanks to everyone who helped test and support.**
- River-Mochi - mod author - Flashbond - collab, tech feedback, testing - yenyang (Recolor, Anarchy) - collab, tech feedback, testing - StarQ - tech feedback, testing - gagaxm, Mayor Cheeks - surface-hide requests and testing - Dx, BugsyG, Necko1996, ElGendo87, Maestro - testing - =Noel= - images and testing - rzzirrah - image consultant
### Presets
- Tap **1** or **2** to switch presets. - Hold **1** or **2** for 0.5s to save your current colors. - **[⇔]** switches between Set A and Set B = **4 saved custom presets**. - **[↺]** switches between HC defaults and your saved colors.
### 15 Languages
English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Polski, Português Brasil, Português Portugal, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, ภาษาไทย, Tiếng Việt, Türkçe
